description: Record a fact that changes over time (a user's current plan, status, preference, or any value tied to an agent_id and key). To deliberately replace a specific earlier fact, pass its assertion_id in `supersedes`, which links the two so the history stays traceable. Writing WITHOUT `supersedes` to a key that already has a live value is allowed and creates a contested state that is surfaced on the next get_assertion — this is intended, not an error. Costs 1 credit.

context.description: Optional. A project or session tag for provenance.

supersedes.description: Optional. The assertion_id of a specific earlier assertion this one replaces. Omit to record a fresh fact.

ttl_days.description: Optional. Days until this fact stops being current. Omit for no expiry.

valid_until.description: Optional. Absolute expiry as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Use instead of ttl_days when the exact instant is known. Omit for no expiry.

value.description: The current value of the fact.

written_by.description: Optional. Who or what recorded this fact (provenance).

name: store_assertion
